Type: Weapon
Function: Bleeding, bloodthirst, armor piercing
Introduction: A powerful bewitching demon fed this blade with its own blood. Over time, it became exceedingly bloodthirsty. Its edge can cut through solid steel, wounds inflicted by it are difficult to heal, and it absorbs its prey's blood essence to strengthen its owner.
Remark: A blade that does not covet its owner's blood is no good blade.

Type: Orb
Function: Enhancement, defense
Introduction: An item of the Earth Monster class, condensed from the power of the earth. It can enhance strength and defense.
Remark: Heaviness comes at a price.

Type: Vessel
Function: Poison
Introduction: In ancient times, a genius from a witchcraft tribe in the southern mountains set out to create an odorless, colorless poison that killed without a trace. After years of research, he completed this incense burner, only to find its poison weak and slow to act, so he discarded it. Half a month later, everyone in the tribe was dead.
Remark: Did you build up your poison resistance first?
